journey.name: transfer banner opens progress
journey.description:
Verifies that tapping the "TRANSFER IN PROGRESS" banner on Home reopens the "Funds in transfer" screen of the pending transfer to spending at its current step, also after a relaunch. Spark's regtest mines about once a minute and claims a Normal deposit in the first block or two after it, so the journey relaunches right after the first banner tap, while the banner is still up.
Precondition: a Debug build with Spark connected on its regtest, launched against that regtest's Esplora (as spark-transfer-to-spending.xml sets up), a wallet with a positive confirmed on-chain Savings balance, no pending transfer, and at least one activity so Home shows its activity list. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the Savings balance card (testTag "ActivitySavings"), then "Transfer To Spending" (testTag "TransferToSpending"); tap "Get Started" (testTag "SpendingIntro-button") if the intro appears
Tap "Normal" (testTag "SpendingConfirmLater") and swipe the "Swipe To Transfer" handle (testTag "GRAB") fully to the right
Verify the "Funds in transfer" screen (testTag "LightningSettingUp") opens, then tap "Continue Using Bitkit" (testTag "TransferSuccess-button")
Verify Home shows the "TRANSFER IN PROGRESS" banner (testTag "ActivityBanner")

Tap the banner and verify "Funds in transfer" (testTag "LightningSettingUp") opens at its current step: "Processing Payment", or "Payment Successful" once Spark lists the deposit, with "This should take about 30 minutes." (testTag "SettingUpText")
Relaunch the app at once, tap the banner and verify the same screen opens, at the same or a later step
Wait for Spark to claim the deposit until the screen shows the transfer as done (testTag "TransferSuccess"); tap its button and verify Home no longer shows the banner
